prompt: Write a function `compare_semver(v1: str, v2: str) -> int` that compares two Semantic Version 2.0.0 strings. Return -1 if v1 < v2, 0 if v1 == v2, and 1 if v1 > v2. Correctly handle major.minor.patch, prerelease tags (e.g. `-alpha.1 < -alpha.2 < -beta < 1.0.0`), and ignore build metadata (`+build.123`).

tests.test_normal_versions:
assert compare_semver('1.2.3', '1.2.3') == 0
assert compare_semver('1.2.4', '1.2.3') == 1
assert compare_semver('1.2.0', '1.10.0') == -1
assert compare_semver('2.0.0', '1.99.99') == 1
tests.test_prerelease_precedence:
assert compare_semver('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0') == -1
assert compare_semver('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-alpha.1') == -1
assert compare_semver('1.0.0-alpha.1', '1.0.0-alpha.beta') == -1
assert compare_semver('1.0.0-beta', '1.0.0-rc.1') == -1
